_readme: Poora chatbot flow. Code mein koi text/price nahi — sab yahan.
Yes -> business naam+city / maps link -> confirm (Yes / doosra dikhao)
Yes -> analyse? -> connect ask -> video -> connect link -> verify
verified -> health report -> magic QR -> insights -> website -> review reply
-> plans -> plan detail -> buy / talk to sales
FEATURE CHAIN: har feature async deliver hota hai. Backend result bhejta hai,
phir 'features.chain' ke hisaab se agle feature ka button dikhta hai.
LIMITS (loader startup par check karta hai):
buttons max 3 | button title max 20 chars | list rows max 10 | row title max 24
MEDIA: <<<...>>> wale URL placeholder hain — asli URL daalne par hi bhejenge.

features._note: Feature chain ka dimaag. map: button -> feature. chain: feature deliver hone ke baad kaunsa screen. labels: 'preparing...' message ke liye.
